topics.topic_name: Hash output size, encoding & collision/entropy basics
topics.justification: Top terms like bit/byte/character/length/output plus collision, entropy, random indicate questions about hash length/representation and how that relates (or doesn’t) to security properties like collisions and guessing difficulty.

topics.topic_name: Choosing and correctly using bcrypt libraries (implementation guidance)
topics.justification: Words such as bcrypt, secure, library, implementation, code, recommend/suggest point to practical advice on which bcrypt API/library to use and how to implement it safely.

topics.topic_name: Salts: per-user randomness and rainbow table defense
topics.justification: The dominance of salt along with rainbow_table, unique, generate, store, user/database reflects discussion of why and how to generate/store unique per-user salts to defeat precomputation attacks.

topics.topic_name: Storing and verifying password hashes in a database (MD5-era patterns)
topics.justification: password/hash/store/database/check/compare/match plus md5 and login suggest implementation questions about storing hashes and verifying passwords during login, often contrasted with insecure legacy hashes.

topics.topic_name: Pepper and breach threat model (protecting against database compromise)
topics.justification: attacker, compromise, access, database, pepper, protect indicate threat-model discussions about what happens if the DB is stolen and whether adding a server-side secret (pepper) improves security.

topics.topic_name: Client-server authentication and avoiding plaintext password transmission/storage
topics.justification: server, client, send, plaintext/plain_text, authentication, login reflect debates on where hashing should occur (client vs server) and how to avoid sending/storing passwords in plaintext or logs.

topics.topic_name: Password hashing work factor: slow hashes vs brute-force
topics.justification: slow/fast, time, brute_force, crack, iteration, cost, bcrypt strongly indicates tuning and rationale for deliberately slow password hashes to raise attacker computation cost.

topics.topic_name: Password-based encryption vs hashing (key derivation and data encryption)
topics.justification: encrypt/encryption/decrypt, key, derive, secret, file/data point to confusion or guidance about when to encrypt data with a password-derived key versus hashing passwords for authentication.
